verdict.rationale: Plaid has machine-facing status signals: STATUS_UPDATED, STEP_UPDATED and RETRIED webhooks, Link onEvent and onSuccess callbacks, and a /identity_verification/retry endpoint. It also runs per-check verification (data source, documentary, liveness, phone and address risk), and its workflow editor can branch on failures or high-risk sessions. However, the evidence presents granular risk assessments, the overall risk score and the top risk factors as Dashboard displays rather than documented API fields. Failure handling is described as human guidance and Dashboard overrides, so it is unclear whether an external agent can branch on structured reasons. Missing for 10: documented API or JSON schema exposing per-check results, risk scores and risk factors; machine-readable failure reason codes; independent or hands-on corroboration.
